title: Form Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A kind of appraisal form, with limits on how many reviewers an appraisal of this type may have. Every appraisal names its form type.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Maximum 64 characters. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Maximum 256 characters. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Maximum 256 characters. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: MinReviewerLimit
fields.html:
What it is. The fewest reviewers an appraisal should have.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: MaxReviewerLimit
fields.html:
What it is. The most reviewers an appraisal of this type may have.

Example. 5

Why it matters. Adding a reviewer beyond it is refused. 0 means no limit.
